effective_cruise_trim.interpretation: One lumped controller command representing the accumulated translational effect of omitted small reconstructed spacecraft impulses; it is not an additional historical TCM.

current_local_delivery_recalibration.purpose: Match the previously delivered inertial-velocity increment in a local maneuver experiment under the current core and tighter tolerances. Auxiliary initial conditions are not injected into the continuous reconstruction.

main_delivery.method: Full nominal-state PHAROS continuation sampled at 1s. Integrate configured thrust times the sampled inertial body-X axis divided by mass only over the known active burn interval, with 128-point Gauss quadrature. This avoids quadrature across a sampled thrust discontinuity.

trim_delivery.method: Full nominal-state PHAROS continuation sampled at 1s. Integrate configured thrust times the sampled inertial body-X axis divided by mass only over the known active burn interval, with 128-point Gauss quadrature. This avoids quadrature across a sampled thrust discontinuity.

current_delivery_aware_cruise_correction.pointing_mapping: Apply the same inertial rotation to the preceding preparation target and the main-burn target, preserving their existing offset. The existing trim target includes its own preparation. Scale throttles for the desired effective increments and changed propellant mass.
